title: 14 June 1966: Recording: Here, There And Everywhere
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producer: George Martin
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

The backing track for one of Paul McCartney’s Revolver highlights, ‘Here, There And Everywhere’, was begun on this day.

The session began at 7pm and finished at 2am the following morning. The Beatles recorded four takes of the basic track, after which vocal harmonies were overdubbed by McCartney, John Lennon and George Harrison.

These recordings remain unreleased, however, and two days later The Beatles began a remake of ‘Here, There And Everywhere’.
